name: Universal Transformer (+ACT)
q1_graph: One shared transformer block applied recurrently over depth to all positions (dense self-attention graph over tokens).
q2_edges: Attention: dense, input-dependent weights over all token pairs; no sparse edge set.
q3_topology_at_inference: No explicit topology; attention pattern recomputed each step.
q4_state_persists: Yes, per-position state carried across depth steps.
q5_weight_sharing: Full sharing of one block across depth.
q6_training: BPTT through depth; ACT ponder cost per position.
q7_scaling: Scaling UT parameters is far more compute/memory intensive than a vanilla transformer.
q8_stability: ACT hyperparameter sensitivity (see ACT row).
q9_capacity: Turing-complete under assumptions (author claim); low params per FLOP.
q11_gpu: Same kernels as transformers; FLOPs grow with steps.
q13_best_results: bAbI 0.21% error vs 15.2% Transformer; unmatched params/FLOPs.
q14_unexplored: UT vs sparse learned graph at matched params+FLOPs: not found in our search.

name: Looped transformers (programmable / ICL / length generalisation)
q1_graph: Small transformer block looped with input injection; output re-fed each loop.
q6_training: Fan et al. train with known step counts per instance; other training details unknown.
q8_stability: Without input injection performance deteriorates beyond trained loops; weight-tied model diverges.
q9_capacity: Hard-coded <13-layer looped transformer emulates a computer (construction).
q10_more_iterations_help: With input injection: stable fixed point beyond 30 trained loops (linear regression).
q13_best_results: Adaptive-step looping improves length generalisation (author claim).
q14_unexplored: Learned sparse topology inside the loop: not found in our search.

name: Looped k-layer x L (Saunshi et al.)
q1_graph: k-layer block looped L times; compared to k-layer (iso-param) and kL-layer (iso-FLOP).
q6_training: unknown
q7_scaling: Downstream accuracy scales with log of effective depth.
q8_stability: unknown
q9_capacity: Worse perplexity/memorisation than iso-FLOP model; reasoning near iso-FLOP with L times fewer params.
q10_more_iterations_help: Accuracy rises with effective depth, logarithmically.
q13_best_results: k x L nearly matches kL-layer on addition, p-hop, math (iso-FLOP).
q14_unexplored: Graph-structured block at same k x L budget: not found in our search.

name: Huginn recurrent-depth LM
q1_graph: Prelude (2 layers) -> core 4-layer block iterated r times with input injection -> coda (2 layers).
q4_state_persists: Yes; latent state iterated per token, random init.
q6_training: Truncated BPTT through last k=8 iterations; r sampled log-normal Poisson, mean 32.
q8_stability: Two failed runs: hidden-state collapse and recurrence collapse; fixed by architecture/init.
q9_capacity: 1.5B core reused; storage limited by 3.5B params.
q10_more_iterations_help: Gains to 50B-FLOP-equivalent (authors); independent: marginal gains, non-settling dynamics.
q11_gpu: Dense transformer kernels; 87% achievable FLOP utilisation on AMD MI250X.
q13_best_results: 5x GSM8k vs non-recurrent twin at 180B tokens (params matched-ish, FLOPs not).
q14_unexplored: Sparse/graph core block at matched FLOPs: not found in our search.

name: Ouro LoopLM
q1_graph: Full-stack layer loop (R up to 4) with exit gate and LM head per step.
q6_training: Entropy-regularised objective over exit distribution; per-step LM losses.
q7_scaling: 1.4B and 2.6B params, 7.7T tokens; ~1.4x forward FLOPs of 4B dense (derived).
q8_stability: Adaptive exits collapse to shallow depth or overuse loops without regularisation.
q9_capacity: ~2 bits/param, same as non-looped: no extra storage.
q10_more_iterations_help: Peaks at trained T=4, degrades at T=5-8.
q11_gpu: KV reuse in prefill costs >10 GSM8K points.
q12_repos: No GitHub repo cited; models via project page ouro-llm.github.io.
q13_best_results: 1.4B/2.6B match 4B/8B dense (param-matched only).
q14_unexplored: Ouro vs equal-FLOP dense model trained on same 7.7T data: not found in our search.

name: Parcae (stable looped LM)
q1_graph: Prelude-recur-coda looped transformer with constrained (negative-diagonal) injection matrix.
q6_training: unknown

q9_capacity: 770M matches 1.3B transformer on Core (param, not FLOP).

q13_best_results: +2.99 Core vs parameter-matched transformers (FLOPs unmatched).
q14_unexplored: Same stability analysis for sparse graph recurrence: not found in our search.

q11_gpu: DEQ-Transformer 3x slower than Transformer-XL; 1.5x after Jacobian reg.
q12_repos: locuslab/deq and locuslab/mdeq, MIT, PyTorch, stale since 2021-2022.
q13_best_results: MDEQ 77.5% ImageNet top-1 at ResNet-101-like params.
